visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark hair and light makeup stands in a bright indoor setting, holding a black cushion foundation in her left hand and a liquid foundation bottle in her right hand. She smiles at the camera, wearing a black top and small hoop earrings, against a soft-focus white wall. (2) The scene cuts to extreme close-ups of her face, showing the texture of her skin after applying different foundations. Bold black and white text overlays appear at the top and bottom of the frame, highlighting the product names and their effects on her cheek and chin area. (3) The creator is seen wearing a black headband with pink accents. She points to her bare face, explaining her skin type (sensitive and mixed). She then uses a red Armani-branded cushion puff to apply the product to the left side of her face using dabbing motions. (4) She transitions to applying the liquid foundation on the right side of her face, using a different green-trimmed puff. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the contrast between the dewy finish of the cushion and the matte finish of the liquid foundation. (5) The woman is shown outdoors walking on a sidewalk with trees and parked scooters in the background. The natural daylight reveals how the makeup has held up after six hours of wear. She moves her face close to the camera to show the lack of oxidation. (6) Back indoors, she uses the cushion to touch up her nose area, demonstrating its layering capability. She concludes the video by holding both products again, gesturing with her hands while encouraging viewers to share their preferences in the comments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice begins with a bright greeting, introducing foundation products. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic track featuring strummed guitar and a light rhythmic beat. The speaker's pitch is moderate, and her tone is enthusiastic and inviting. (2) During the application phase, the voice becomes more detailed and descriptive, maintaining a consistent pace without many pauses. The BGM continues steadily at a moderate volume level, providing a cheerful bed that does not interfere with the clarity of her speech. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition to the outdoor segment. Here, faint ambient wind noise and distant traffic can be heard behind her voice, which remains the primary focus. She sounds confident as she reviews the makeup's performance after several hours. (4) The audio concludes with a final summary. The voice rises in pitch slightly at the end of sentences, characteristic of a Call to Action. The acoustic BGM swells slightly in volume before fading out as she finishes her closing remarks and encourages audience interaction.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Application Comparison -> Wear Test Results -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comparative review and demonstration of two Giorgio Armani foundation products. The creator aims to showcase the different finishes (dewy vs. matte) and long-wear performance of the cushion and liquid foundations to help viewers decide which product best suits their skin type and needs.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently features the Giorgio Armani logo, product names, and provides a detailed review of their performance, typical of a professional beauty endorsement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-frequency jump cuts and clear text overlays to maintain a fast, social-media-friendly pace while delivering detailed product information. The comparison of two modalities of foundation on the same face provides strong visual evidence for the claims.
